description: A minimal, SEPARATE admin web surface at /admin: the blueprint's distinct-route admin app with NO bot chat composer (an 'Open in member app' link-out instead), consuming the /admin/* API routes from FEAT-003. Per docs/architecture/02-control-plane-ia.md the admin surface must not carry the bot composer. Decision (justified against the existing web structure): a distinct ROUTE GROUP within the existing Vite app rather than a second build target -- the app already uses react-router-dom in web/src/main.jsx with the application routes nested inside <Shell> (which owns the Composer). The admin surface is a sibling route group rendered OUTSIDE <Shell>, with its own minimal AdminShell layout and no Composer import, gated by AuthGate + isOwner. A second build target would duplicate the auth0/api plumbing for no isolation benefit at single-tenant scale; a separate route with its own shell and no composer satisfies the 'entirely different account interface' intent while reusing auth. Document this decision in a comment and in the task follow-ups (true origin-isolation is a v1.5 item).
steps: Read web/src/main.jsx (the <Routes> tree), web/src/app/Shell.jsx (to see what to NOT reuse -- the Composer/chat), web/src/auth0.jsx (isOwner), and an existing simple screen (e.g. web/src/screens/Usage.jsx) for the data-fetching + styling conventions (no UI framework; plain JSX + styles.css/premium.css classes).

Create web/src/admin/AdminShell.jsx: a minimal layout (header 'AmazAI Admin', a stronger-auth framing note, nav links to Directory / Kill switch / Audit log, and a prominent 'Open in member app' link to '/' ). It MUST NOT import or render Composer or any bot-chat component. Keep styling consistent with existing screens.

Create web/src/admin/AdminDirectory.jsx: fetches api.admin.directory(), lists members (subject, role, state), and offers the destructive/governance actions -- suspend/reactivate, change role, and per the user's asks a 'Reset onboarding' and 'Archive memory' action targeting a chosen entrypoint bot / bot. Every destructive action uses the blueprint's destructive-action UX: a typed-confirmation (user types the subject/agent id or a keyword) AND a required reason string, before the call fires. Wire reset/archive to api.admin.resetOnboarding(agentId)/api.admin.archiveMemory(agentId).

Create web/src/admin/AdminKillSwitch.jsx: shows current freeze status from api.admin.killswitch(), and a set control (freeze/unfreeze) behind the same typed-confirm + reason UX (freezing an org is the most destructive control).
Create web/src/admin/AdminAudit.jsx: renders api.admin.audit() as a chronological read-only list (action, actor, at, detail, correlationId). Read-only, no mutation controls.

Wire the routes in web/src/main.jsx: add a sibling <Route path="/admin" element={<Protected><AdminOnly><AdminShell/></AdminOnly></Protected>}> with nested index/directory/killswitch/audit routes, rendered OUTSIDE the <Shell> route element. Add an AdminOnly guard (mirror PublicOnly/SetupOnly) that redirects non-owners (isOwner(user)===false) to '/'. Ensure the '*' catch-all still works and /admin does not fall into FirstRunGuard (an admin must not be walled into onboarding).

Add demo/fixture support: extend web/src/demo.js so the /admin screens render with ?demo=1 against fixtures (a small members list, an unfrozen killswitch, a couple of audit rows) WITHOUT leaking demoApi into a production build. After building, the demo-leak guard grep -c demoApi web/dist/assets/*.js MUST be 0.

Add lightweight component tests following the existing *.test.jsx pattern (e.g. web/src/components/ApprovalCard.test.jsx) for at least: AdminDirectory renders members and BLOCKS the reset/archive/suspend call until the typed confirmation matches and a reason is entered (assert the api wrapper is not called before confirmation, and IS called after); AdminShell renders NO composer (assert the Composer component / a chat input is absent). Run them with the web test runner (check package.json 'test' script; likely vitest).
Run cd web && npm run build && test -f dist/index.html && confirm grep -c demoApi dist/assets/*.js == 0. Run the web test suite. Run the full python suite + infra synth to confirm nothing regressed.
acceptance_criteria: A /admin route group renders OUTSIDE <Shell> with its own AdminShell and NO bot chat composer; it offers an 'Open in member app' link-out.
AdminDirectory lists the directory and offers reset-onboarding, archive-memory, suspend/reactivate/role-change, each behind a typed-confirmation + required reason before the /admin API call fires.
AdminKillSwitch shows and toggles the freeze behind the same confirm+reason UX; AdminAudit is a read-only chronological log.
Non-owners are redirected away from /admin; /admin is not captured by the first-run onboarding guard.
Component tests prove the destructive actions are blocked until confirmed and that AdminShell renders no composer.
cd web && npm run build produces dist/index.html and grep -c demoApi dist/assets/*.js == 0 (no demo leak).
Python suite still green apart from the 3 pre-existing failures; infra synth passes.
verification: cd web && npm run build && test -f dist/index.html && test $(grep -c demoApi dist/assets/*.js) -eq 0
cd web && npm test  (or the script defined in web/package.json)
findings:
Implemented the /admin route group as a sibling of the app routes, rendered OUTSIDE <Shell> (which owns the Composer), so it imports no bot-chat component. New files: web/src/admin/AdminShell.jsx (header + Directory/Kill switch/Audit nav + prominent 'Open in member app' link-out; the WHY-comment documents the sibling-route decision and v1.5 origin-isolation follow-up), AdminDirectory.jsx, AdminKillSwitch.jsx, AdminAudit.jsx, and a shared ConfirmAction.jsx that gates every destructive/governance action behind a typed confirmation token PLUS a required reason (onConfirm is never invoked until both match). Directory offers suspend/reactivate, change-role, reset-onboarding and archive-memory, all wired to the existing api.admin.* wrappers (FEAT-003). main.jsx: added AdminOnly guard (mirrors PublicOnly; redirects non-owners via isOwner(user)===false to '/', bypassed in DEMO where there is no principal) and the /admin route group; it is deliberately NOT under FirstRunGuard so an admin is not walled into onboarding, and the '*' catch-all still trails it. CSS appended to styles.css (admin-* classes; also added .state-chip tone-color rules since the existing ones were scoped to .chat-who). demo.js already had a full demoApi.admin block and ADMIN_* fixtures from FEAT-003; extended ADMIN_MEMBERS to a small 3-member list (active/active/suspended) and seeded 2 ADMIN_AUDIT rows so the screens render meaningfully under ?demo=1. Tests: AdminDirectory.test.jsx (members render; suspend/reset/archive all blocked until typed-confirm + reason, asserted via within(dialog)) and AdminShell.test.jsx (no textbox/textarea/.composer). No hardcoded password anywhere.

ENVIRONMENT NOTE for later features: the web test runner (vitest+jsdom) DOES NOT RUN under the Node 18.20.8 that the orchestrator briefing pointed at -- jsdom's html-encoding-sniffer hits ERR_REQUIRE_ESM (@exodus/bytes is ESM-only). The existing suite fails the same way on Node 18, so this is pre-existing, not caused by this change. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) pins Node 22. Use /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin for `npm test`; Node 18 is fine for `npm run build` and the demoApi grep.

VERIFICATION (all green): `npm test` (Node 22) => 23 files / 145 tests passed (was 21 files/141 before; +2 files/+4 tests). `npm run build` => dist/index.html present, grep -c demoApi dist/assets/*.js == 0 (no demo leak). `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q` => only the 3 documented tests/test_gaps_api.py failures, no new ones. `cd infra && npx cdk synth` => exit 0. Committed as a520350; only source files staged (the tracked __pycache__/*.pyc churn from pytest was deliberately left unstaged per the context note).

REVIEW-FIX ROUND 1 (commit dbe3cae, web portion): Addressed review issues #1, #2, #4 on the web surface. (#1 role picker) AdminDirectory.jsx ROLES now sources the six real server enum values: ['owner','admin','security','billing','member','auditor'] -- dropped the invalid 'viewer' and reached the three previously-unassignable roles. (#2 thread reason) Every run(reason) closure now forwards the reason: api.js admin.suspend/reactivate/resetOnboarding/archiveMemory take a reason arg and POST { reason } in the body; changeRole folds reason into its body. demo.js stubs mirror this via a new withReason() helper so the demo audit trail reads the same. (#4 scope agent actions) Reset-onboarding/archive-memory buttons now render only on the Owner's row (m.role === 'owner'), the only row that maps to a real agent under the single-tenant seam (org_id == user_id); on other rows they would 400/404. RESIDUAL (noted): fully general scoping needs a backend agent listing the console does not yet have; surfacing on the Owner row + labelling the seam in comments is the minimal correct thing, consistent with the review. Updated AdminDirectory.test.jsx: renamed/rewrote the reset+archive test to assert exactly one of each button exists (Owner-scoped) and that calls carry the reason ('you','stale setup' / 'you','privacy request'); suspend test asserts suspend('auth0|teammate','off-boarding'). `npm test` (Node 22) => 23 files / 145 tests still passing; `npm run build` (Node 18) => demoApi count 0. Issue #5 (org-wide budget cap wired to kill switch) left as the deliberately-deferred follow-up per task.json -- NOT built.
